Sample.evidence_source: In a previous publication from our psychological autopsy study (Kiamanesh, Dyregrov, Haavind, & Dieserud, 2014), we showed the dynamic leading from perfectionism to suicide. Perfectionism seemed to be an important element in the suicides of six men with no history of attempted suicide or treatment in mental health care. ... The present study aimed to explore the conditions that may predispose individuals to maladaptive perfectionism eventually influencing the suicide process.

Type.evidence_source: In a previous publication from our psychological autopsy study (Kiamanesh, Dyregrov, Haavind, & Dieserud, 2014), we showed the dynamic leading from perfectionism to suicide. ... The present study aimed to explore the conditions that may predispose individuals to maladaptive perfectionism eventually influencing the suicide process. Through a phenomenological approach, using qualitative methods of analyses, we explored the life histories from the perspective of several informants who perceived the deceased's life history in different ways, depending on his or her relationship to the deceased.

Area.evidence_source: Perfectionism seemed to be an important element in the suicides of six men with no history of attempted suicide or treatment in mental health care. Striving for success was the life project of these men, associated with a fear of failure and a strong urge to keep up the fac¸ade. This combined with rigidity, made these men unable to cope with self-experienced failures or adapt to significant negative life events. They seemed to have experienced failures as an irreversible defeat, and eventually suicide became their "solution."
